rows.claim: EAGLE-3 achieves a speedup ratio up to 6.5x, with about 1.4x improvement over EAGLE-2. In the SGLang framework, EAGLE-3 achieves a 1.38x throughput improvement at a batch size of 64.
rows.note: Table 1 max EAGLE-3 cell is 6.47x (V 13B, HumanEval, T=0); the section 4.1 text says 'up to 6.5x'. Abstract's 1.38x at bs=64 matches Table 3.

extraction.method: pdftotext cross-checked against rendered pages 1, 7, 8 (200-220 dpi, viewed); all printed, no chart reads.

caveats: Table 3 batch sizes 2..64 (9 values); Table 5 (vLLM, RTX3090/A100 label mismatch within paper: text says RTX3090, caption says A100; no bs=64) not extracted as not requested.
Table 1 has 48 EAGLE-3 cells (4 models x 6 cols x 2 temps = 48 rows incl. Mean); V13B T=0 HumanEval 6.47x is the max, text rounds to 6.5x.
Table 3 baseline is SGLang w/o speculation; Table 1 baseline is vanilla autoregressive generation.
